An editorial illustration displays a magazine cover with a textured, golden-brown background framed by a red border. At the top, a red banner contains the white text "MAUT DI BAWAH TANAH FREEPORT". Below this, the large white word "TEMPO" is centered. Smaller white text below it reads "EDISI 27 MEI-2 JUNI 2013".

In the center, a circular emblem features the text "TEMBAKAU RUU PASAL 3-4" surrounded by several star-like shapes. Below the emblem, large white block letters state "AGAR MEROKOK DIANGGAP SEHAT".

Near the bottom, a white rectangle with a black border contains black text: "ATAS SPONSOR INDUSTRI ROKOK, DPR 'MENYELUNDUPKAN' RUU PERTEMBAKAUAN. IRONI PADA HARI DUNIA TANPA TEMBAKAU."

At the bottom left, vertical text includes "RP 33.000", "WWW.TEMPO.CO", "MAJALAH BERITA MINGGUAN", and "ISSN: 0126-4273". A barcode with the numbers "00013" and "9 770126 427302" is also at the bottom left. The cover's surface shows signs of wear, including faded spots and scratch-like marks.
